scenes.name: TWELVE VERSUS FIFTEEN
lines: Can geometry tell us the exact number of quantum measurement rules that must fail? Here the answer is no.
几何能否准确告诉我们，至少多少条量子测量规则必须失败？这里答案是否定的。
A family of seventy-five lines needs twelve failures, but every classical hexagon shares fifteen of its lines.
一个 75 线族最少错 12 条，而每个经典六边形都与它共享 15 条线。
To see why, start with a puzzle: give each point a plus or minus sign, and multiply the three signs on each line.
原因从一个游戏开始：每点填正负号，再把每条线上的三个符号相乘。

scenes.name: THE PARITY PUZZLE
lines: Here X, Y, and Z label measurements; I means identity. Each row and column is a rule, with only the last column negative.
X、Y、Z 表示测量，I 表示恒等操作。每行每列是一条规则，只有最后一列要求负的乘积。
Every point appears twice. Multiplying all six rules gives plus one on the left, but minus one on the right. One rule must fail.
每个点出现两次。六条规则相乘，左边是正一，右边却是负一，所以至少错一条。
The full two-qubit geometry has ten contradictory grids. Each line belongs to four, forcing at least three failures. All plus signs fail exactly three negative lines.
完整两比特几何有十个矛盾方阵，每条线属于四个，因而至少错三条。全部填正号，又恰好只错三条负线。

scenes.name: FOUR LIFTS
lines: Now use the pole called I I Z. Give every two-qubit point two copies, by appending I or Z, and add the pole.
现在取极点 I I Z。每个两比特点末尾分别加 I 或 Z，形成两个副本，再加上极点。
Each base line has four lifts with the same sign. Fifteen pole lines and sixty lifted lines make seventy-five.
每条底层线有四种同号提升，15 条极点线加 60 条提升线，共 75 条。
Copy an optimal base assignment to both copies. Three base failures become twelve lifted failures, while every pole line is satisfied.
把最优底层赋值抄给两个副本。三条底层错线变成十二条提升错线，而全部极点线满足。

scenes.name: WHY TWELVE IS OPTIMAL
lines: For the lower bound, select one copy of every point using a rule that preserves binary addition. There are sixteen such linear sections.
为证明下界，用保持模二加法的规则从每对副本选一个；这样的线性截面有十六个。
Each section is a whole two-qubit geometry and needs three failures. That gives at least forty-eight section-failure incidences.
每个截面都是完整两比特几何，至少错三条，因此至少有四十八次截面与错线的关联。
Every non-pole line is counted four times, and pole lines are never counted. Dividing forty-eight by four forces twelve distinct failures.
每条非极点线计数四次，极点线不计数。四十八除以四，强迫至少十二条不同的错线。

scenes.name: WHY FIFTEEN IS FORCED
lines: Now forget assignments and count geometry. The thirty-one points commuting with the pole meet every ambient line in either one point or three.
现在不看赋值，只数几何。与极点交换的三十一个点，与每条环境线相交于一点或三点。
A hexagon has sixty-three lines, with three through each point. The thirty-one selected points therefore contribute ninety-three incidences.
六边形有六十三条线，每点三线。因此选中的三十一个点贡献九十三次关联。
If k lines lie entirely inside, the count is three k plus sixty-three minus k. Solving gives fifteen, whereas the degree is twelve.
若有 k 条线完全在内部，计数就是三 k 加六十三减 k。解得十五，而度数却是十二。

scenes.name: WHAT THE COUNTEREXAMPLE SAYS
lines: The intersection is still an upper bound, but it can be strict for every classical embedding. Earlier special cases remain intact.
交集仍是上界，却可能对每个经典嵌入都严格。已有特殊情形结论保留。
Lean verifies the negation of the universal equality using a positive degree at most twelve and intersections at least fifteen. The exact counts have written proofs.
Lean 用正度数至多十二、交集至少十五，验证了普遍等式的否定。精确数值另有书面证明。
This is the counterexample of Haobo Ma and Wenlin Zhang, answering the generalization proposed by Saniga and colleagues. Which extra hypotheses restore equality?
这是 Haobo Ma 与 Wenlin Zhang 对 Saniga 等人推广猜想给出的反例。哪些附加假设能恢复等号？
